prompt:
[quiet, tired] Four twenty. Frank's downstairs, in the circle. And I'm up here. Almost two hours till six.

[quiet, shaken] Gus is gone. I saw it on thirteen.

[quiet, tense] Someone knocked downstairs. Three times. The way Frank asked. Except he asked me to do it.

Lily was standing at the entrance. In the rain, no umbrella. Lily was asleep three hundred kilometers away.

[whispering, terrified] I opened it. She came in and smiled. Too wide.

[quiet, tense] The lights started going out. Floor by floor. Top to bottom. Toward me.

[quiet, tired] The voice faded. Frank was breathing hard. The server room had the recorder: every camera on one monitor.
[calm, sweet, creepy] Ethan… Come down to me. You can hear so well up here…

[old man, tired, firm] Watch the cameras. Anything wrong, you log it. That's how I waited for morning for twenty years.

[old man, low, serious] Don't stare at the static. It looks back out of it.

[old man, quiet, scared] If I go after the voice, hold me back. Whatever I say.

[old man, tired, warm] Twenty to six. Hang in there, kid.
